lab.name: Wireless Intelligence Lab
lab.tagline: Intelligence for wireless networks from the ground to space. We explore next-generation wireless systems through aerial and space networking, online optimization and control, and agentic AI for autonomous network operation.
lab.affiliation: School of Electronic and Electrical Engineering, Sungkyunkwan University
lab.address: School of Electronic and Electrical Engineering · Suwon 16419
lab.recruitment: We are seeking motivated graduate students and undergraduate researchers interested in next-generation wireless systems, optimization and control, and autonomous network intelligence. If you are interested in joining our group, please contact Prof. Lee at kisonglee@skku.edu with a brief introduction, research interests, and CV.

professor.role: Professor, School of Electronic and Electrical Engineering
professor.interest: Online/offline optimization, energy ICT, information security, aerial and satellite communications, agentic AI communications

education.text: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, KAIST (Advisor: Prof. Dong-Ho Cho)

experience.text: Associate Professor / Assistant Professor, Chungbuk National University

graduate.interest: UAV placement and beamforming, LEO satellite systems
UAV communications, non-terrestrial networks, federated learning

research.title: Aerial & Space Networks
research.text: We study the design and optimization of aerial and space wireless networks incorporating UAVs, LEO satellites, and terrestrial systems. Our research includes UAV trajectory and deployment optimization, mobility-aware communications, satellite beam placement, and space-air-ground integrated networking.

research.title: Online Wireless Optimization
research.text: We develop online optimization frameworks for wireless networks under time-varying traffic, channel, mobility, and environmental conditions. Our research focuses on Lyapunov optimization, model predictive control, real-time environment sensing and prediction, and adaptive resource management.

research.title: Agentic AI Communications
research.text: We study agentic AI frameworks for autonomous wireless systems, where AI agents perceive the environment, reason about user and system objectives, and plan communication strategies. Our research focuses on adaptive decision-making, network control, and closed-loop learning from real-time feedback.
